planets.name: HD 20329 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 20329 with a 0.926-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: HD 20329 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 20329. Its orbit and size follow Murgas et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
